name: Ray Ali
title: Ray Ali — Cloud, Applications & Automation
intro: I bring ideas to life through cloud architecture, application development, and automation — with the power of AI.
about: I’m Ray. I turn ideas into useful digital experiences, connecting the possibilities of AI with cloud architecture, application development, and automation. My projects are a place to explore what’s possible and put those ideas to work.

services.title: Cloud Architecture
services.description: A cloud foundation shaped around your idea. Architecture and infrastructure that support your application today and give it room to grow.

services.title: Application Development
services.description: Bring a concept to life as a usable application. From the first screen to the working product, with AI helping move ideas forward.

services.title: Automation
services.description: Make repetitive work happen automatically. Connect tools, streamline workflows, and turn manual steps into systems that work for you.
